items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So sure enough, J. D. turned out to be a lovable person... And we all, we get to be friends easily. Children always do, right?

ctx.x: Yeah, that's it. That's how you would come out of a hand stand. He did it in one of the east side -- I think it was the East Side Kids movie -- the Bowery Boys, something you know. With the Step Brothers -- that's what he done it with. He was a loader, you know. They had went to some stock room, you know, they had loaded the truck, you know, and they'd be tap dancing. They was doing the Step Brothers dance and while loading these properties on to this truck. And each one of them would do some kind of a tap step…
